process.title: Packing and moving: how it works in practice
process.intro: The “packing and moving” service is the perfect solution if you want peace of mind. Instead of packing on your own for weeks, a professional team handles everything fast.

steps.title: Preparation stage:
steps.text: Movers arrive with everything needed — sturdy boxes (single and double wall), tape, stretch wrap, packing paper, and bubble wrap.

steps.title: Packing stage:
steps.text: The team packs the home systematically. Fragile items are wrapped separately, books go into smaller boxes, and clothes are packed neatly.

steps.title: Labeling:
steps.text: Each box is clearly marked with its room and contents (for example, “Kitchen – fragile” or “Kids room – toys”).

steps.title: Moving and unloading:
steps.text: After packing, everything is loaded onto the truck and delivered to the new home. Boxes are placed in the right rooms according to labels.

process.note: Important to know: in most cases, packing and moving happen on the same day, from morning until late afternoon. In very large apartments, packing may take place the day before the move.

tips.title: Smart packing tips before the movers arrive
tips.intro: Even if you booked packing services — and especially if you pack yourself — a few steps will make the move smoother:
items: Sort and declutter: if you didn’t use something in your current home, you won’t use it in the new one. Donate or discard it. Less volume means a cheaper move.
First-night bag: prepare a separate bag with essentials — a change of clothes, toothbrushes, chargers, medication, and towels — so you don’t search through dozens of boxes when you arrive tired.
Valuables: jewelry, important documents, cash, and laptops should go with you in your car. Don’t send them with the moving truck.
Packing drawers: in some dressers you can leave items in the drawers and wrap the entire dresser with stretch film to save box space.
Keep the hardware: if you disassembled furniture, put all screws and small parts in one bag and attach it to the furniture or keep them in a dedicated box.

timing.title: When should you start packing?
timing.intro: If you pack on your own, the biggest mistake is waiting until the last minute. Self-packing should begin about six weeks before the move.

items.title: Weeks before:
items.text: Pack items kept in storage or those you don’t use daily.

items.title: Two weeks before:
items.text: Start packing books, décor, and rooms that are rarely used.

items.title: One week before:
items.text: Pack most clothes, toys, and kitchen items you won’t need soon.

items.title: Two days before:
items.text: Finish packing the kitchen and leave only basic dishes for the final days.

timing.outro: Want to skip all of this? Order packing through us and everything will be done in one or two focused days!

items.question: How long does it take to pack an apartment?
items.answer: A professional packing crew can pack a 3–4 room apartment in one workday (about 6–8 hours). Larger apartments may require an additional packing day before the move.

items.question: Can I order packing without moving?
items.answer: Yes, you can order packing only, but it’s usually more cost-effective to book a combined packing + moving package.

whenUse.title: When do you need apartment storage services?
whenUse.intro: Life is dynamic, and sometimes there’s a gap between leaving your old home and moving into the new one. Apartment storage is a great solution in many scenarios:

items.title: Major renovation:
items.text: during renovations, furniture can be damaged by dust, paint, or impacts. Storing items offsite protects them and gives contractors space to work.

items.title: Relocation or long trip:
items.text: leaving for an extended period? There’s no need to pay rent just for furniture. A container or storage unit is safer and more cost-effective.

items.title: Gap between leases:
items.text: the most common case — you moved out of one apartment and get the new key a month later.

items.title: Limited space at home:
items.text: received an inheritance or need extra space? Rent a small personal storage unit for seasonal items or sentimental belongings.

chooseStorage.title: How to choose a storage facility for apartment contents
items: Security and protection: make sure the facility has 24/7 cameras, is connected to a security center, and includes smoke detection and fire suppression.
Cleanliness and pest control: the storage must be clean, ventilated, and regularly treated to prevent pests and rodents.
Insurance: confirm the storage company provides comprehensive insurance for stored items and review coverage limits and deductibles.
Access and availability: if you need access during the storage period, check access policies, required scheduling, and any extra fees for item retrieval.

items.title: Short-term storage:
items.text: ideal for moves and renovations. The focus is on flexibility and availability. Monthly pricing is often slightly higher, but commitments are shorter.

items.title: Long-term storage:
items.text: best for relocation or items not used daily. Use sealed, airtight packing (“shrink wrap”) to prevent dust and humidity. Longer commitments often come with discounted rates.

tips.title: Packing tips before storage
tips.intro: Packing for storage differs from packing for a regular move. Items sit longer and are more sensitive to pressure and humidity. Here are our expert tips:

items.title: Appliances:
items.text: defrost and dry refrigerators/freezers at least 24 hours before pickup and leave doors slightly open during storage to prevent odors.

items.title: Sturdy boxes:
items.text: use strong double-wall cartons and avoid overloading them to prevent crushing items below.

items.title: Fragile items:
items.text: wrap glass and porcelain generously with packing paper and bubble wrap.

items.title: Do not store:
items.text: flammables, leaking liquids, or food (which attracts pests).

priceFactors.title: What determines the cost of an apartment move?
priceFactors.intro: The final quote is based on several factors. Understanding them helps you get an accurate price and avoid surprises on moving day:

items.title: Volume and type of belongings:
items.text: This is the main factor. The more items you have, the larger the truck and crew required.

items.title: Moving distance:
items.text: Is it within the city (e.g., within Tel Aviv) or a long-distance move (e.g., from Haifa to Be’er Sheva)? The longer the distance, the more fuel and time affect the cost.

items.title: Access and floors:
items.text: Is there an elevator? Is it large enough? Moving from the 4th floor without an elevator requires more labor and costs more.

items.title: Special items:
items.text: Moving a piano, safe, or antique furniture requires special equipment and extra care and is priced separately.

items.title: Additional services:
items.text: Do you need packing, disassembly/assembly, or a crane? Each additional service affects the price.

items.title: Move date:
items.text: Apartment move prices peak in summer (July–August). If you can be flexible and move in winter, you can save quite a bit.

solutions.title: Moving solutions for every need (not only apartment moves)
solutions.intro: Our portal’s advantage is the ability to provide a solution for any type of move, in any situation:

items.title: Small moves (from 249 ₪):
items.text: Don’t pay full price for a truck if you only need to move a sofa, refrigerator, or a single box. We’ll find you a mover for a small move at a modest price.

items.title: Apartment moves of any size:

items.title: Full moving services:

items.title: Nationwide coverage:

items.title: Urgent moves (same day):

items.title: Special availability:
items.text: Need a Friday or Saturday move? We have movers available on weekends as well (subject to traffic and rest regulations).

tips.title: Preparation and essential tips before the move
tips.intro: To make moving day smooth, here are a few key tips from thousands of customers’ experience:

items.title: Declutter and sort:
items.text: Moving is the perfect time to get rid of what you don’t need. Donate, sell, or throw away unused items. Fewer belongings = a cheaper and faster move.

items.title: Pack smart:
items.text: Label every box clearly with its contents and destination room. Pack a separate “survival kit” for the first night: toiletries, a change of clothes, phone chargers, and some food and water.

items.title: Photograph connections:
items.text: Before disconnecting the TV, computer, or audio system, take photos of the cables. It will save hours of frustration in the new apartment.

items.title: Keep valuables with you:
items.text: Jewelry, important documents (passports, contracts), and laptops should go in your personal car. Don’t load them onto the moving truck.

items.title: Check the new apartment:
items.text: Make sure the new place is clean and ready to receive your furniture. The last thing you want is to place a clean sofa on a dirty floor. A proper move starts with clear expectations.

items.text: through us you can order a packing team that arrives a day before the move to pack files, catalogues, and employees’ personal items.

items.title: Smart labeling:
items.text: the recommended method is to mark each box with the room/workstation number and employee name. Movers place every box in the right spot at the new office, making unpacking faster.

items.title: What about old equipment?
items.text: an office move is a great chance to declutter. Identify unused furniture and computers and donate or recycle them instead of paying to move them.

tips.title: Tips to cut moving costs

items.question: How long does an office move take?
items.answer: A small-to-medium office can usually be moved in one day (or one night). Large offices with dozens of employees may require two to three days. Proper planning keeps it minimal.

definition.title: What is a small move?
definition.text: A small move (or “single-item move”) is any move that doesn’t require a large truck and a full crew. It’s usually handled by a small mover with a closed commercial vehicle or pickup. That flexibility keeps the price significantly lower than a full apartment move.

audience.title: Who is the small move service for?
audience.intro: It’s a perfect solution for many situations:

items.title: Student moves
items.text: Moving out of a rental? Need to move a bed, desk, small fridge, and a few boxes? A small move is exactly what you need.

items.title: Single-item moves (second-hand / stores)
items.text: Bought a sofa, fridge, or wardrobe on Facebook Marketplace or Yad2? Found an item in a store but shipping is too expensive? A small mover can deliver it home for less.

items.title: Young couples and renters
items.text: Need to add a washing machine, move a baby crib from parents, or remove an old piece of furniture? No need to pay for a full truck.

items.title: Add-ons and removals
items.text: Before a big move, or when you just need to clear an old sofa downstairs or move a wardrobe across the city.

priceFactors.title: What affects the price of a small move?

items.title: Distance:
items.text: Is it within the city or between cities? Longer distances increase cost due to fuel and time.

items.title: Access, floor, and elevator:
items.text: Is there an elevator and is it large enough? Moving to the 3rd floor or higher without an elevator costs more.

items.title: Disassembly and assembly:
items.text: Beds, wardrobes, and large tables require dismantling. You can request a quote that includes this service.

items.title: Urgency:
items.text: Need it today? Through our portal you can find movers that offer express service, sometimes with a small extra fee.

items.title: Special items:
items.text: Moving a piano, safe, or large glass item requires special equipment and skilled crew, so pricing differs.

popularServices.title: Popular services in a small move

items.title: Fridge moving
items.text: Moving a fridge requires care. Make sure movers are experienced and have proper equipment (like a stair dolly) and keep it upright whenever possible. Unplug it a few hours before the move.

items.title: Sofa or living room moving
items.text: The main challenge is fitting through doors and stairwells. Measure the sofa and passage widths in advance. If it doesn’t fit, you may need a small move with a crane. Movers will wrap it in stretch film to prevent tears and dirt.

items.title: Washing machine moving
items.text: A washing machine is heavy and bulky. Before moving, disconnect it from water and power and drain it. Make sure movers secure the drum with the original bolts (if you kept them) to prevent damage.

crane.title: When do you need a small move with a crane?
crane.intro: Sometimes the only way in or out is through a balcony or a large window. A small move with a crane is needed when:
items: an item (like a large sofa, mattress, piano, or fridge) doesn’t fit in the stairwell or elevator;
in high-rise buildings where manual carry is too costly and risky;
to prevent damage to a valuable item that can’t be disassembled.
crane.outro: Through our portal you can request quotes from movers who provide professional crane services.

cheap.title: How to get a small move for less (our method)
cheap.intro: Everyone wants to save. Here are 3 ways our platform helps reduce costs:

items.title: Smart price comparison:
items.text: Instead of chasing movers, movers compete for your job. That pushes them to offer their best price and helps you save up to 45%.

items.title: Small move en route (the winning tip):
items.text: If you’re moving one item and it’s not urgent, say so. We’ll find a mover already traveling the same route who can add your item for a nominal fee.

items.title: Flexibility and preparation:
items.text: Being flexible with the date (mid-week is cheaper) and disassembling/packing yourself reduces time and lowers the quote.

items.question: Can I book a small move for today?
items.answer: Absolutely. It’s one of the biggest advantages of small movers. Their flexibility often allows express service. Through our portal you can find movers available within a few hours.

items.question: What’s the difference between an “en route” move and a regular move?
items.answer: A regular move is dedicated to you: the mover arrives and drives directly to the destination. An “en route” small move means your item is added to an existing route. It may take longer and requires flexibility, but the price drops significantly.

items.question: Do I need to pack items myself?
items.answer: For a single item (like a fridge or sofa), the mover will usually wrap it with blankets and film. If you’re moving a studio with boxes, you’ll need to pack them in advance unless you order packing services for an extra fee.

items.question: I received a much cheaper quote. How do I know it’s reliable?
items.answer: That’s exactly why you should use our portal. All movers are vetted for reliability and reviews. A price that’s too low can be a red flag—sometimes it means unprofessional movers who raise the price on moving day. With us, you only get offers from verified pros.

challenges.title: Tel Aviv moving challenges: parking, traffic, and lifting cranes
challenges.intro: Tel Aviv is a dense city, and any move here requires planning. Here are the main challenges — and how professional movers handle them:

items.title: Parking shortage:
items.text: most central streets don’t have space for a large truck. Experienced movers arrive with a suitable vehicle size or coordinate an early arrival time. Our tip: “reserve” a spot the night before by parking your personal car there.

items.title: Buildings without elevators:
items.text: Tel Aviv has many older or protected buildings without elevators. In such cases, using a lifting crane is often almost mandatory. A crane can lift furniture and large appliances through a balcony or window, saves time, and reduces the risk of damage in stairwells.

items.title: Traffic and road load:
items.text: the best time to move in Tel Aviv is early morning (before 07:00) to avoid congestion on Ayalon and in the city center.

bullets: With us, you’ll find a network of movers with vans and small trucks who specialize in small moves in Tel Aviv. The advantage? Lower prices and flexible timing.
What can be moved? Fridges, washing machines, sofas, beds, wardrobes, and individual boxes. Price: from ₪249 for one item within the city.

officeMoves.title: Office and business moves in Tel Aviv

items.title: Box delivery:
items.text: you can order boxes and packing materials (tape, bubble wrap) directly from the mover at discounted prices.

items.question: How far in advance should I book movers in Tel Aviv?
items.answer: In busy periods (summer, end of the month), it’s best to book 2–3 weeks ahead. In winter, you can often find availability within a few days. If you’re stuck last-minute, our system can still find available movers even for same-day moves.

comparison.title: Upright piano vs. grand piano moving

items.title: Upright piano:
items.text: typically weighs 150–250 kg. It is moved by 2–3 carriers using special lifting straps. The piano is wrapped in blankets and stretch film and moved on a dolly to the truck.

items.title: Grand piano:
items.text: much heavier with a unique shape. Moving requires removing the legs and pedals. The piano is wrapped, laid on its side on a special skid, and transported carefully. Usually 4 movers or a crane are required.

crane.title: When do you need a crane for piano moving?
crane.intro: Sometimes the stairwell is too narrow, the elevator is too small, or the piano is simply too heavy to move safely by stairs. In these cases, a crane is the most efficient and safest solution. Crane advantages:
items: Maximum protection: the piano doesn't bump walls or shake on stairs.
Speed: the move can be completed in minutes.
Cost: even with an extra fee, it is cheaper than repairing damage to a piano or building walls.

preparation.title: Preparing the piano and retuning
preparation.intro: To keep the move safe, follow these tips:

items.title: Lock the lid:
items.text: make sure the keyboard lid is closed and locked (if there is a key) to prevent key damage.

items.title: Take photos:
items.text: photograph the piano from all angles before the move to document its condition.

items.title: Retuning:
items.text: pianos can go out of tune during transport due to temperature, humidity changes, and minor vibrations. Wait about 2–3 weeks after the move so the piano acclimates, then call a tuner.

stairs.title: Staircase moving — when is it possible?
stairs.intro: Moving a piano in a stairwell is physically demanding. It is possible when:
items: the stairwell is wide enough to turn the piano on landings;
there are at least 2 strong, experienced movers (more for a grand piano);
the piano is securely fastened to the movers' straps.
stairs.outro: If there is any doubt about the passage width, it is always safer to choose a crane.

items.question: How many movers are needed to move a piano?
items.answer: For a standard upright piano, 2–3 movers are usually enough. For a grand piano or very heavy upright piano, 4 movers or more are required.

items.question: Do you wrap the piano?
items.answer: Yes. Movers wrap the piano in stretch film, thick blankets, and cardboard to protect it from scratches, bumps, and moisture during transit.

items.question: What tip is customary for piano movers?
items.answer: Tips are typically higher than for regular moves due to the physical effort and responsibility. The common range is 50–100 ₪ per mover depending on complexity (floors, stairs, etc.).

items.question: Is insurance included in the price?
items.answer: Most professional movers provide insurance, but it's important to confirm this in advance and ask to see the policy, especially for valuable instruments.
